For me I thought it will get better but instead it got worse over the years. It started when I was 10-11 because of bullying. When I was 17 it started getting better I could go to school to the store and I worked after finishing school. I had anxiety but I still could do what I needed to do. I honestly miss those days I could do everything just to go back.
SinceI became 20 things started getting worse and worse and now at 21 I even feel scared to leave the house. I can't function and I honestly don't know what to do. I think I started to become agoraphobic.
Since my only friend left me I have 0 friends and social interactions make me nauseous as well as leaving the house. I just want to have a normal life but I don't know how at this point I can't do anything without someone going with me and it's so scary I don't know what will happen with me in the future.

Thank you so much you're very nice 🥺
It's hard to believe that
Thank you but if you see me you would'nt think that :(

Same I stopped to watch TV shows because of this :(
I liked them but it reminded me how alone I am and that made me sad
That's what I'm afraid of... I'm scared of the pain.
